DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease (Left Hip)

The imaging findings of femoral head fragmentation and flattening, combined with your limp and lack of acute inflammatory signs, confirm the diagnosis. I recommend starting conservative management with restricted weight-bearing activities for the next few weeks.
